newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia RTS index ends up 7.4 pct at record 481.13.
newsitem.headline: Russia RTS index ends up 7.4 pct at record 481.13.

text.p: The Russian Trading System 22-share index soared 7.4 percent on Thursday to close at a record 481.13 after Wednesday's record 447.94 closing, the NAUFOR brokers association said.

An official figure for total market turnover was unavailable but unofficial data on volumes of individual stock sales indicated that turnover would likely top the previous $100.27 million record set on Wednesday.
